gate_questions.acceptance_standard: Aggregate EV/PnL improve, at least two EV-improved windows, no EV-regressed windows, survival_rate >= 5%, max drawdown damage <= 2 pp, then implement only through shared production/backtest policy.
gate_questions.alpha_hypothesis: risk allocation: all-core relative-TQS same-day sector follower haircut
prior_similar_experiments: exp-20260511-006 rejected a blunt same-sector risk_on follower haircut.
exp-20260511-010 improved EV/PnL but touched only late_strong because it was risk_on-only.
gate_questions.reproducibility: Script reruns baseline and variant across all docs/backtesting.md fixed snapshots and writes JSON/MD artifacts.
gate_questions.single_causal_variable: relative-TQS 0.5x same-day same-sector follower risk multiplier across core A/B entries

gate4.decision_basis: Shared promotion requires aggregate EV/PnL improvement, at least two EV-improved windows, no EV-regressed windows, survival-rate constraints, max drawdown damage <= 2 pp, and a nonzero touched cohort.

hypothesis: Same-day same-sector core A/B clusters may be useful when the follower is high quality, but lower-TQS followers should receive a 0.5x initial risk haircut across all core entries.
next_evidence_needed: Do not repeat all-core same-sector TQS follower haircuts on this frozen sample; valid retry needs forward cluster-quality evidence or a different orthogonal discriminator.

eligible_entries: same signal-day sector already has one eligible core entry
leader and follower trade_quality_score are present
parameters.quality_condition: follower trade_quality_score < first same-sector core signal trade_quality_score

rejection_reason: Gate 4 did not justify shared-policy promotion.
